title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Credits for Bank Errors and Courtesy Late Fee Waivers
content:
A charge posted to a box rental under the Safe Deposit Boxes product can be offset by a credit. This policy governs the two credit reasons that are not tied to giving up or changing a box: correcting the bank's own error, and waiving a late fee as a courtesy.

## Rules every credit follows

- A credit is linked to exactly one charge on the rental (a rent charge, a fee or a deposit), and the credit is never larger than that charge.
- A given charge receives at most one credit for any one reason. Before a credit is recorded, the bank's record of credits already linked to that same charge is what shows whether the reason has been used.

## Bank error credits

A bank error credit reverses a charge the bank should not have made under the product's own terms. Examples include rent billed with the wrong branch adjustment, rent billed without a discount the lessee was entitled to, and a late fee levied on rent that was in fact paid inside the grace days. There is no cap on how many bank error credits a customer can receive.

## Courtesy waivers

A courtesy waiver can be given only against a late fee, never against rent, a service fee or a deposit. It is available only while the customer's count of courtesy waiver credits, taken over all of that customer's box rentals within the rolling 365 calendar days that end on the current date, is below the allowance shown in the table for the size of the box whose late fee is being waived.

| Box size | Courtesy late fee waivers allowed per rolling 365 days |
|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 1 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 2 |

### Hypothetical illustrations

| Hypothetical situation | Result |
|---|---|
| 10x10 lessee, no courtesy waiver in the last 365 days, asks to waive a late fee | Count 0 is below 1; a courtesy waiver is available |
| 10x10 lessee, one courtesy waiver on another of the customer's boxes 200 days ago | Count 1 is not below 1; no courtesy waiver |
| 10x20 lessee, one courtesy waiver 300 days ago | Count 1 is below 2; a courtesy waiver is available |
| Same customer asks for a courtesy waiver on a key deposit | Not available; courtesy waivers apply to late fees only |
| Late fee charged although the rent was paid on the last grace day | Bank error credit, whatever the courtesy count |
| A late fee that already carries a courtesy waiver credit | No second courtesy waiver credit on that fee |

## Credits tied to surrender and size changes

Credits for unused rent, a returned key deposit, or unused months on a move between sizes are governed by the terms for surrendering a box and changing its size, and not by the bank error or courtesy rules above.
